title: Grateful Dead Live at Pershing Municipal Auditorium on 1973-02-26
lineage: S:MR > cassette > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a high‑energy February ’73 show, highlighted by a smoking Dark Star > Eyes of the World > Half Step and inspired Jerry Garcia solos.
ai_review.review: The recording is a solid soundboard source that presents the band in top form, though the mix lets Billy Kreutzmann’s ride dominate at times.  The performance shines with a monster Dark Star sequence, superb Jerry solos on Greatest Story Ever Told, and tight renditions of China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider, Big Railroad Blues, and Playing in the Band.  Overall the show is high‑energy and memorable despite a few missing tracks in the archive.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4–5 stars and praise its musical highlights; recording is generally good with only minor mix imbalance, yielding a strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear soundboard capture overall, but the right channel (Billy's ride) is mixed forward and can be tedious; some archive versions miss a few songs, though the official Dick's Picks release fills most gaps.

standout_songs: Dark Star > Eyes of the World > Half Step
China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
Going Down The Road Feeling Bad
poor_songs: Not Fade Away > Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad (mix issues)
Box of Rain & El Paso (average performance)
show_quality.setlist_flow: A long, dynamic first set that builds into a tightly sequenced second set; transitions flow well and keep the momentum high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Extremely inspired playing with standout solos on Greatest Story Ever Told and throughout Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Phil: Generally solid bass work but missed a couple of cues during Tennessee Jed.
band_member_comments.Bob: Sharp rhythm guitar and vocal contributions; praised especially on Lucy and other cuts.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy Kreutzmann’s ride is mixed forward and at times overwhelming, though his drive underpins the high‑energy grooves.
